_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Coalesced tool calls display the agent's text and the tool separately. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /new.
2. Fill the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) with "bash: pwd" and click the send button ([data-testid="send-button"]).
3. Wait for the first [data-testid="tool-call-completed"] element to be visible (allow 30s).
4. The agent's message is shown: the first element ("*" with has_text, nth 0) whose text contains "I'll run the command: pwd" is visible. Present text is not enough; it must be visible.
5. The tool result is shown separately as a coalesced tool call: the first [data-testid="tool-call-completed"] element is visible, and the first element ("*" with has_text, nth 0) whose text contains "bash" is visible.
